title: Tomo muted the club music in GTA 6... so it became a silent disco
description: On his first GTA 6 stream, Tomo walked into a nightclub with the music muted for YouTube and turned it into a silent disco.
hook_text:
NO MUSIC IN THE CLUB?
GTA 6 SILENT DISCO
first_comment: GTA 6 club with no music: still a vibe, or totally dead? 👇
